items.text:
Game is worth 10-15$ so get it on sale. I enjoy the game but I'm gonna have to side with the consensus that this game is NOT a 1.0 version game and is janky in many many ways. They literally JUST patched it so you wouldn't shoot things you were dragging as the game didn't realize you didn't want to shoot whatever you're dragging in your hands. 

The game is a great concept but seemingly is gonna go the way of Neo Scavenger where they just say "Okay BYE!" and leave before the going actually gets good. I don't understand why someone who obviously is inspired and has a great game wants to suddenly rug pull and move onto something else.

EDIT: Usually they update every 7 days. it's been 10 days since 1.0 launch and no update.... Do with that info what you will.
items.text_zh:
这游戏值10-15美元，所以打折时再买。我喜欢这游戏，但我得站到共识那边：这游戏不是1.0版本该有的样子，而且在很多很多方面都很粗糙。他们刚刚才打了补丁，让你不会朝自己拖着的东西开枪，因为游戏之前没意识到你不想朝手里拖着的东西开枪。

这游戏概念很棒，但看起来会走上Neo Scavenger的老路：他们直接说一句“好，拜拜！”然后在真正变好之前就撒手不管了。我不理解，一个显然有灵感、手里有一款好游戏的人，为什么会突然掀桌跑路去做别的东西。

编辑：通常他们每7天更新一次。1.0发布已经过去10天了，还没有更新……这信息你怎么用随你。
